description_en: Basaḥ Hiti is one of threehitislocated next to each other at the base of the Imūdvã hillock in Lalitpur. The neighborhood is mainly inhabited by the members of Poḍe caste who . Therefore, thehitiis commonly used by them.The termvāsaḥmeans medicine in the Newari language, and thus, it is believed that water from thishiticontains medicinal properties. It is said that the Rāṇā rulers used to drink water from the Vāṣah Hiti (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 42). Thehitihas two water spouts. A statue of Bhagīratha is installed underneath the main spout (LAL0994-001) and a statue of Umāmaheśvara is placed above it.The date of construction of thehitiis not recorded but it is assumed that it was built during the reign of Prime Minister Juddha Śamśera Rāṇā [r. 1932-1945] (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 39).A certain Jayarāja Śreṣṭha renovated thehitiin 1999 CE (VS 2056) and in 2011 CE (VS 2068) local residents, with the financial support from the Lalitpur Sub-metropolitan City, built a water storage and distribution system for the benefit of the local community. This system is still functioning.A minor renovation of thehititook place in 2017 CE (VS 2074) when thehitisandphalcāsin the Ālko quarter were repaired with funds from the World Bank and the Lalitpur Municipality. Unfortunately, little attention was paid to the use of authentic materials for the renovation. Due to rapid urbanization resulting in groundwater depletion, the flow of water in thehiticonsiderably decreases during the dry season. The local community cleans and worships thehition the day of the Sithinakhaḥ, the sixth day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha.
description_ne: ललितपुरको आल्को हिति (LAL0990) पछाडि पोडेहरूको बसोबास रहेको इमूद्वँ भनिने थुम्को छ । उक्त थुम्कोसँगै तीनवटा हिति निर्माण गरिएका छन् । ती तीनवटा हितिमध्ये वास: हिति पनि एक हो । नेवारीमा ‘वासः’को अर्थ ‘औषधि’ हो । यस हितिको पानीमा औषधिको गुण भएको विश्वास गरिन्छ । यसै गुणको कारणले राणा शासकहरूले पनि यस हितिको पानी प्रयोग गर्थे  (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 42) । रोग निको हुने विश्वासले अहिले पनि यस हितिमा नुहाउन आउनेहरू पाइन्छन् । यस हितिमा दुईवटा टुटीहरू बनाइएका छन् । मुख्य टुटी (LAL0994-001) मुनि भगीरथको मूर्ति राखिएको छ भने टुटीमाथि उमामहेश्वर स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो हितिको निर्माणबारे कुनै अभिलेख नपाइए पनि राणा प्रधानमन्त्री जुद्धशमशेरको पालामा निर्माण गरिएको अनुमान गरिएको छ (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 42) । विसं २०५६ (सन् १९९९) मा जयराज श्रेष्ठले[1]हितिको मर्मत गरेका थिए । विसं २०६८ (२०११) मा ललितपुर उपमहानगरपालिकाको आर्थिक सहयोगमा टोलवासीहरू मिलेर पानीलाई ट्याङ्कीमा जम्मा गरेर वितरण गर्ने प्रणाली बनाइएको थियो । यो प्रणाली अहिलेसम्म पनि निरन्तर चलिरहेको छ ।विसं २०७४ (सन् २०१७) मा प्व:त्वा: (आल्को) मा रहेका हिति र फल्चाहरूको पुनर्निर्माण-मर्मत गर्ने परियोजना अन्तर्गत यस हितिको पनि सामान्य मर्मत गरिएको थियो । विश्व बैंककोआर्थिक सहयोगमा ललितपुर उप-महानगरपालिकाले हितिको सामान्य मर्मत गरेको थियो । बढ्दो शहरीकरणले गर्दा जमीनमुनि पानीको सतह घट्दै गएकाले सुख्खा याममा पानीको प्रवाह घट्न थालेको छ, तर हिति सुकेको छैन । वर्षको एकपल्ट ज्येष्ठ शुक्ल ६ (सिथिनख:) को दिनमा टोलवासीहरू मिलेर हिति सफा गर्छन् ।Footnotes^ललितपुर उप–महानगरबाट हितिमा टाँसिएको अभिलेखमा गल्तीवश जयराज श्रेष्ठको ठाउँमा ‘जयराज शाक्य’ लेखिएको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: ThehitiID plaque was installed by the Heritage Conservation Centre, Lalitpur Metropolitan City, and Centre for Integrated Urban Development (CUID). It is part of their project of inventorizing such heritage sites of Lalitpur.
Vāsaḥ Hiti was repaired through the initiative of Jayarāja Śreṣṭha.
PURPP (Pro-Poor Urban Regeneration Pilot Project) and Lalitpur Metropolitan City installed this introductory signboard at thehiti. Its date is not mentioned.

In 2011 CE (VS 2068), local residents, with the financial help from the Lalitpur Sub-metropolitan City, established a system to collect water into a reserve tank and to distribute it proportionately. This system is still functioning.
Thehitiwas repaired by the Lalitpur Metropolitan City with funding from the World Bank.
